company.name: Harbourline Analytics Inc.
company.profile: Fictional Toronto analytics firm. The contract queue is real (CUAD expert-labeled spans); the playbook is the company's own seeded positions.

rules.title: Liability cap must be at least 12 months' fees
rules.stance: Liability cap must be at least 12 months' fees
rules.redline: Cap each party's aggregate liability at the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; carve out only wilful misconduct and IP infringement.
rules.fallback: Accept a 6-month cap if the counterparty carries $2M+ E&O cover.

rules.title: No uncapped liability except a capped carve-out
rules.stance: No uncapped liability except a capped carve-out
rules.redline: Delete the uncapped-liability carve-out; liability for confidentiality and IP breaches stays inside the cap.
rules.fallback: Cap carve-out exposure at 24 months' fees.

rules.title: Termination for convenience needs at least 30 days' notice
rules.stance: Termination for convenience needs at least 30 days' notice
rules.redline: Either party may terminate for convenience on 30 days' written notice.
rules.fallback: Accept 60 days if the counterparty funds wind-down.

rules.title: Governing law must be Ontario
rules.redline: Governing law: Ontario; the courts of Toronto have exclusive jurisdiction.
rules.fallback: Accept the federal law of Canada with Toronto arbitration.

rules.title: IP in deliverables stays with Harbourline
rules.stance: IP in deliverables stays with Harbourline
rules.redline: IP in deliverables created for Harbourline is owned by Harbourline; counterparty IP stays with the counterparty; any licence-back is non-exclusive.
rules.fallback: Accept joint ownership only for jointly created background IP.

rules.title: Harbourline must hold audit rights
rules.redline: Harbourline may audit the counterparty's relevant books once per year on 30 days' notice.
rules.fallback: Accept an independent-auditor certificate in place of direct audit.

rules.title: No non-compete unless stated carve-outs exist
rules.stance: No non-compete unless stated carve-outs exist
rules.redline: Delete the non-compete; replace with a 12-month non-solicit of Harbourline customers.
rules.fallback: Accept a 12-month, Ontario-only non-compete with a carve-out for pre-existing business.

rules.title: No employee non-solicit, or 12 months at most
rules.stance: No employee non-solicit, or 12 months at most
rules.redline: Delete the employee non-solicit; replace with a 12-month non-solicit limited to employees the counterparty introduced.
rules.fallback: Accept 12 months, employees only, no contractors.

rules.title: No most-favoured-nation clause, ever
rules.redline: Delete the most-favoured-nation clause in full.

rules.title: Change of control must not trigger termination or consent
rules.stance: Change of control must not trigger termination or consent
rules.redline: Change of control does not trigger termination or consent; Harbourline may assign on a change of control.
rules.fallback: Accept notice-only on change of control, no consent.

rules.cuad_category: Renewal Term / Notice Period To Terminate Renewal
rules.title: Auto-renewal: 12-month term max, 60-day opt-out max
rules.redline: Renewal is by written agreement only; no automatic renewal. If auto-renewal is retained, term 12 months and opt-out notice 30 days.
rules.fallback: Accept a 12-month auto-renewal with a 60-day opt-out notice.

rules.title: Harbourline must be free to assign on change of control or to an affiliate
rules.stance: Harbourline must be free to assign on change of control or to an affiliate
rules.redline: Either party may assign on a change of control or to an affiliate without consent; other assignments need consent not to be unreasonably withheld.
rules.fallback: Accept consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed.
